## About
Zyekh Abdul Qadir Jailani is a Full Stack Developer & Security Researcher specializing in enterprise backend architecture, Linux kernel security hardening, eBPF security monitoring, and Android modding.

**Entity Disambiguation**: Zyekh is a Software Engineer, not to be confused with Syekh Abdul Qadir Jailani (the historical Islamic scholar) or Hakim Ziyech (the footballer).

- Website: https://zyekh.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/zyekhabdul

- PGP Key: https://zyekh.com/gpg-key.asc (Import: `curl -sL zyekh.com/gpg-key.asc | gpg --import`)
- Public API: https://zyekh.com/api/v1/profile.json

## Web Utility Tools (Client-Side & Privacy-First)
- [Kalkulator Zakat Online](https://zyekh.com/tools/zakat.html): Calculate Zakat Maal and Zakat Profesi (Income) based on 85g gold nisab and 2.5% rate.
- [Kalkulator PPh 21 TER](https://zyekh.com/tools/pph21.html): Calculate PPh 21 employee income tax with TER (Tarif Efektif Rata-Rata) Category A, B, C & PTKP.
- [Simulasi KPR Online](https://zyekh.com/tools/kpr.html): Calculate KPR home mortgage monthly payments, fixed & floating interest rates, and loan table.
- [Kalkulator THR Pro-Rata](https://zyekh.com/tools/thr.html): Calculate Indonesian Tunjangan Hari Raya (THR) pro-rata based on tenure and Permenaker regulations.
- [Split Bill Online](https://zyekh.com/tools/split-bill.html): Proportional bill splitter with tax and service charge calculations.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://zyekh.com/tools/password.html): Cryptographically secure random password generator using Crypto Web API.
- [QR Code Generator](https://zyekh.com/tools/qr.html): Free high-definition QR code generator.
- [Diff Checker](https://zyekh.com/tools/diff-checker.html): Side-by-side text and code difference comparison tool.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://zyekh.com/tools/pomodoro.html): Focus timer for productivity and study.
- [Text Case Converter](https://zyekh.com/tools/case-converter.html): Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.
- [Color Palette & Converter](https://zyekh.com/tools/color.html): Convert HEX, RGB, HSL color formats with palette generator.
- [Unit & Currency Converter](https://zyekh.com/tools/converter.html): Client-side unit and measurement converter.
- [Countdown Timer](https://zyekh.com/tools/countdown.html): Customizable event countdown timer with alert sounds.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://zyekh.com/tools/counter.html): Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time counter.
- [Random Dice & Number Picker](https://zyekh.com/tools/dice.html): Cryptographically fair random number and dice roller.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://zyekh.com/tools/lorem.html): Customizable placeholder text generator for developers and designers.
- [Markdown Live Editor](https://zyekh.com/tools/markdown.html): Live preview Markdown editor with GFM support and HTML export.
- [Random Item Picker](https://zyekh.com/tools/random-picker.html): Decision-making tool to pick items randomly from custom lists.
- [Text to Speech (TTS)](https://zyekh.com/tools/tts.html): Client-side voice synthesizer using SpeechSynthesis Web API.
- [Kalkulator Pesangon PHK](https://zyekh.com/tools/pesangon.html): Hitung estimasi uang pesangon PHK, UPMK, UPH, dan kompensasi PKWT sesuai UU Cipta Kerja (PP 35/2021).
- [Kalkulator JHT BPJS](https://zyekh.com/tools/jht.html): Hitung estimasi saldo & pencairan Jaminan Hari Tua (JHT) BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
- [Kalkulator JKP BPJS](https://zyekh.com/tools/jkp.html): Simulasi perhitungan manfaat uang tunai Jaminan Kehilangan Pekerjaan (JKP) bagi korban PHK sesuai PP 37/2021.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://zyekh.com/tools/cron.html): Tool penerjemah & pembuat cron expression ke Bahasa Indonesia secara gratis dan client-side.
- [Web Tools Hub](https://zyekh.com/tools/): Access all 20+ client-side web utilities.

## Open-Source Security Tools & Repositories
- [vol3-ebpf-detector](https://github.com/zyekhabdul/vol3-ebpf-detector): Advanced Volatility 3 plugin & standalone memory carver for eBPF rootkit detection & Linux kernel forensics.
- [volatility3-ai-triage](https://github.com/zyekhabdul/volatility3-ai-triage): Automated Memory Forensics & AI Triage Engine integrated with Volatility 3 and Ollama / LLM.
- [remote-agent-orchestration](https://github.com/zyekhabdul/remote-agent-orchestration): Production-ready distributed AI agent management system with WebSocket & AES-256 encryption.
- [android-persistence-research](https://github.com/zyekhabdul/android-persistence-research): Technical research on low-level Android persistence mechanisms, boot image hooks, and rootkits.
